source.title: TECHNICAL IMPLEMENTATION GUIDANCE - ENISA
source.applicability: Cybersecurity risk management for NIS2-relevant entities, specifically covering configuration settings for emergency administrative access as referenced in password management for privileged accounts

passages.text: Documented policy on the security of network and information systems which contains the elements required by points 1.1.1 (a) to 1.1.1 (k) of the Annex to the regulation.
